entries.title: Matthew 13:1
segments: ¶On the same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the sea.

entries.title: Matthew 13:2
segments: And great multitudes were gathered together to Him, so that He got into a boat and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

entries.title: Matthew 13:3
segments: Then He spoke many things to them in parables, saying: "Behold, a sower went out to sow.

entries.title: Matthew 13:4
segments: "And as he sowed, some [seed] fell by the wayside; and the birds came and devoured them.

entries.title: Matthew 13:5
segments: "Some fell on stony places, where they did not have much earth; and they immediately sprang up because they had no depth of earth.

entries.title: Matthew 13:6
segments: "But when the sun was up they were scorched, and because they had no root they withered away.

entries.title: Matthew 13:7
segments: "And some fell among thorns, and the thorns sprang up and choked them.

entries.title: Matthew 13:8
segments: "But others fell on good ground and yielded a crop: some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

entries.title: Matthew 13:9
segments: "He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"

entries.title: Matthew 13:10
segments: And the disciples came and said to Him, "Why do You speak to them in parables?"

entries.title: Matthew 13:11
segments: He answered and said to them, "Because it has been given to you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it has not been given.

entries.title: Matthew 13:12
segments: "For whoever has, to him more will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.

entries.title: Matthew 13:13
segments: "Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they do not see, and hearing they do not hear, nor do they understand.

entries.title: Matthew 13:14
segments: "And in them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says: 'Hearing you will hear and shall not understand, And seeing you will see and not perceive;

entries.title: Matthew 13:15
segments: For the hearts of this people have grown dull. Their ears are hard of hearing, And their eyes they have closed, Lest they should see with [their] eyes and hear with [their]  ears, Lest they should understand with [their] hearts and turn, So that I should heal them.'

entries.title: Matthew 13:16
segments: "But blessed [are] your eyes for they see, and your ears for they hear;

entries.title: Matthew 13:17
segments: "for assuredly, I say to you that many prophets and righteous [men] desired to see what you see, and did not see [it], and to hear what you hear, and did not hear [it].

entries.title: Matthew 13:18
segments: "Therefore hear the parable of the sower:

entries.title: Matthew 13:19
segments: "When anyone hears the word of the kingdom, and does not understand [it], then the wicked [one] comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is he who received seed by the wayside.

entries.title: Matthew 13:20
segments: "But he who received the seed on stony places, this is he who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy;

entries.title: Matthew 13:21
segments: "yet he has no root in himself, but endures only for a while. For when tribulation or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

entries.title: Matthew 13:22
segments: "Now he who received seed among the thorns is he who hears the word, and the cares of this world and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

entries.title: Matthew 13:23
segments: "But he who received seed on the good ground is he who hears the word and understands [it], who indeed bears fruit and produces: some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty."

entries.title: Matthew 13:24
segments: ¶Another parable He put forth to them, saying: "The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field;

entries.title: Matthew 13:25
segments: "but while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat and went his way.

entries.title: Matthew 13:26
segments: "But when the grain had sprouted and produced a crop, then the tares also appeared.

entries.title: Matthew 13:27
segments: "So the servants of the owner came and said to him, 'Sir, did you not sow good seed in your field? How then does it have tares?'

entries.title: Matthew 13:28
segments: "He said to them, 'An enemy has done this.' The servants said to him, 'Do you want us then to go and gather them up?'

entries.title: Matthew 13:29
segments: "But he said, 'No, lest while you gather up the tares you also uproot the wheat with them.

entries.title: Matthew 13:30
segments: 'Let both grow together until the harvest, and at the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, "First gather together the tares and bind them in bundles to burn them, but gather the wheat into my barn."'"

entries.title: Matthew 13:31
segments: Another parable He put forth to them, saying: "The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his field,

entries.title: Matthew 13:32
segments: "which indeed is the least of all the seeds; but when it is grown it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches."

entries.title: Matthew 13:33
segments: Another parable He spoke to them: "The kingdom of heaven is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal till it was all leavened."

entries.title: Matthew 13:34
segments: All these things Jesus spoke to the multitude in parables; and without a parable He did not speak to them,

entries.title: Matthew 13:35
segments: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying: "I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things kept secret from the foundation of the world."

entries.title: Matthew 13:36
segments: Then Jesus sent the multitude away and went into the house. And His disciples came to Him, saying, "Explain to us the parable of the tares of the field."

entries.title: Matthew 13:37
segments: He answered and said to them: "He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.

entries.title: Matthew 13:38
segments: "The field is the world, the good seeds are the sons of the kingdom, but the tares are the sons of the wicked [one].

entries.title: Matthew 13:39
segments: "The enemy who sowed them is the devil, the harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are the angels.

entries.title: Matthew 13:40
segments: "Therefore as the tares are gathered and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of this age.

entries.title: Matthew 13:41
segments: "The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will gather out of His kingdom all things that offend, and those who practice lawlessness,

entries.title: Matthew 13:42
segments: "and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

entries.title: Matthew 13:43
segments: "Then the righteous will shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear!

entries.title: Matthew 13:44
segments: ¶"Again, the kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field, which a man found and hid; and for joy over it he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

entries.title: Matthew 13:45
segments: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant seeking beautiful pearls,

entries.title: Matthew 13:46
segments: "who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had and bought it.

entries.title: Matthew 13:47
segments: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some of every kind,

entries.title: Matthew 13:48
segments: "which, when it was full, they drew to shore; and they sat down and gathered the good into vessels, but threw the bad away.

entries.title: Matthew 13:49
segments: "So it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come forth, separate the wicked from among the just,

entries.title: Matthew 13:50
segments: "and cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be wailing and gnashing of teeth."

entries.title: Matthew 13:51
segments: Jesus said to them, "Have you understood all these things?" They said to Him, "Yes, Lord."

entries.title: Matthew 13:52
segments: Then He said to them, "Therefore every scribe instructed concerning the kingdom of heaven is like a householder who brings out of his treasure [things] new and old."

entries.title: Matthew 13:53
segments: ¶Now it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these parables, that He departed from there.

entries.title: Matthew 13:54
segments: And when He had come to His own country, He taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, "Where did this [Man] get this wisdom and [these] mighty works?

entries.title: Matthew 13:55
segments: "Is this not the carpenter's son? Is not His mother called Mary? And His brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

entries.title: Matthew 13:56
segments: "And His sisters, are they not all with us? Where then did this [Man] get all these things?"

entries.title: Matthew 13:57
segments: So they were offended at Him. But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor except in his own country and in his own house."

entries.title: Matthew 13:58
segments: Now He did not do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
